option.name: extra_seeds
option.semantics: BUILD option on verify_mode='all8_both_seeds' (tools/coopmwm/verify_perseed.py): for every decision with at least one within-seed COOPERATIVE example on seeds 1/2, each such plan (distinct candidate index) is re-verified together with the policy-continues reference on CRN seeds 3..(2+extra_seeds); one batched group verification per extra seed. Each (plan, extra seed) is admitted INDEPENDENTLY by the same per-seed rules (within-seed per-second paired block bootstrap lower95 > 0 + own-seed composite MAIN04:26 safety + own-seed measured extended-window later-harm), then gets its own batched solo verification on THAT seed (roots named like the kinds: confirm_seed<k>_all8, confirm_extended_seed<k>_all8, confirm_solo_all8_s<k>). Admitted examples are APPENDED to per_seed_v1.examples with seed_index >= 3 (own plan/tape/label), so the per_seed_v1 bank rule consumes them unchanged. Arms B and R use the identical code path. No cross-seed requirement; seeds >= 3 never alter the seed-1/2 examples, mean_replicated_advantage_veh_s (seeds-1/2 admission mean), the legacy replicated flag (now '{1,2} <= cooperative seeds of the plan'), or the exact gate.
option.salt_convention: seed 2 keeps the existing replicate(snapshot, vid) salt; extra seed k >= 3 uses replicate(snapshot, extra_seed_salt(vid, k)) with salt = f'{vid}#seed{k}' - a pure deterministic function of the first-seed verification_id and k only (distinct from the seed-2 salt, from every other extra seed, and from every other vid). The replicate() generator seed implied by the salt is checked against the evaluation world-seed ranges 962000-962999 / 964000-964199 / 977000-977999 (EVAL_SEED_RANGES); in the collision case the salt is deterministically re-derived with a '#x<n>' suffix, so no evaluation seed is ever a CRN generator seed input. Documented in verify_perseed.extra_seed_salt and the module docstring.

record_new_when_on: extra.{k} per extra seed k=3..2+n: seed_index, salt, kind, verification_id, status, snapshot_sha256, receipt_sha256, root, candidates (cooperative candidate indices), J_policy_veh_s, extended (verification_id/status/receipt_sha256/candidate_indices or null), later_harm_measured=true, solo_root
record_extended_when_on: winners gains one key per extra seed (strings '3'..'2+n'); distinct_winners_across_seeds stays the seed-1 vs seed-2 comparison
per_seed_v1.examples gains the appended seed_index>=3 examples (admitted_seeds/cooperative_seeds derive from examples unchanged)
keys.record_unchanged_when_off: with extra_seeds=0 (or the key absent) no new keys are written, no extra verify() calls are made, and records/receipts/charges are byte-identical (test_extra_seeds_zero_is_byte_identical; the only difference between two roots is the bank's absolute path inside the record and its own seal digest over it)
keys.config: binding 'sumo_verify' config key extra_seeds (replay_bank.collect passes it to confirm_pending only when set); builder BINDING.json key extra_seeds (bank_builder.run_all8_round -> vp.confirm_all8; extra-seed verifications are conditional on the seeds-1/2 cooperation labels so they are charged LIVE through rb._confirm_charge - only the seed-2 all-K branches are precharged)
keys.api: vp.confirm_all8(..., extra_seeds=0), vp.confirm_pending_all8(..., extra_seeds=0), rb.confirm_pending(..., extra_seeds=0)
keys.cli: python -m tools.coopmwm.verify_perseed extra-seeds [--n N] (default n=4) prints extra_seeds_quote(n); the existing 'quote' command is unchanged
keys.charges: every extra verification (group, extended, solos) goes through the SAME hooks as seeds 1/2: sv.verify -> runner.admit (disk guard) -> rb._confirm_charge(run_root, phase, kind) with kind in {confirm_seed<k>_all8, confirm_extended_seed<k>_all8, confirm_solo_all8_s<k>}, warm_health.assert_running checked before each
